svg.title: A member's agent messages her organization's agent, which admits only adult members and learns neither who wrote nor any claim value
svg.text: THEIR ESTATE — A FACT ARRIVES, A PERSON DOES NOT

g.text: challenge · single use · audience = me · predicate digest
credential + wire (read under her vault grant)
wire covers: this audience · this program · this facet
hides values · issuer sig · device key
bound evidence: digest · venue · predicate digest
presentation → held 10 min under a reference
message · from a pairwise account · cites the reference
pairwise account = f(secret, this door) — no address of hers
facet live? root at seq n?
nullifier consumed ✓ · status root ✓ · the issuer was never asked
pairwise account — no claim, no person
no value · no signature · no key
same credential · same wire shape · one suite per request
no ladder: a predicate request never gets a value back
A message between two agents · the receiver verifies a fact, never a person
